subject: Crestview security intake: trust portal access & vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + security intake next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we covered:
- Product fit: low-latency, hosted inference with Dedicated/private options for PHI workloads
- Data handling: customer-controlled VPC option and KMS integrations for keys
- Compliance: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report and can provide bridge letters / temporary attestation for procurement

Requested from Crestview:
1) Confirm whether you need the full SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter/interim attestation for procurement
2) Complete vendor security questionnaire (we usually accept our DSQ or you can send yours)
3) Access to our trust portal (we’ll provision a read-only account with artifacts)

Immediate next steps I propose:
- I’m attaching a short vendor security questionnaire (PDF) and a response template (Excel) for your team to use. If you’d prefer to send your standard questionnaire, happy to take that.
- Ben (cc) will help with procurement/pricing questions; Monica (security) will provision portal access and share a bridge letter.

If this sounds good, can you confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire and whether you need the full report or interim docs? 

Thanks,
Dylan
--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF, 5 pages); crestview_vsq_response_template.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@crestviewhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + security intake next steps

Thanks Dylan — great demo. A couple of quick clarifications from procurement/security: 

- We will ultimately require the full SOC 2 Type II report for our internal risk team, but for the initial legal review a bridge letter + portal artifacts would be helpful to unblock procurement.
- We have a short vendor questionnaire focused on GDPR/HIPAA controls; I can push that to our security analyst (Priya Shah) to complete.
- For the portal access: can you confirm SSO options (SAML/Okta) and whether temporary accounts support MFA?

I’ll loop Priya into the thread — she’ll own the questionnaire. Can you provide the bridge letter and a trust portal invite so she can start reviewing artifacts this week?

Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships | Crestview Health
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@crestviewhealth.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + security intake next steps

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the quick reply. 

Attaching the vendor security questionnaire (our standard DSQ) and an empty response template to make it easy for your analyst to fill in. Monica is cc’d and will take point on provisioning the trust portal and delivering the bridge letter. 

To answer the SSO/MFA question: our trust portal supports SSO via SAML (Okta, Azure AD). For immediate access we can provision a time-limited account that requires MFA (TOTP or SMS). If you plan to provision via SAML, we’ll need an IdP metadata file. 

What I’ll do now:
- Monica: please provision a read-only trust portal account for priya@crestviewhealth.com and upload the bridge letter + pointer to the SOC 2 artifact package.
- Priya: if you can confirm whether you’ll use the attached template or send your own questionnaire, we’ll prioritize parsing it and returning responses within 3 business days.

HubSpot link for our deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 (adds details and procurement notes).

Thanks,
Dylan
Attachments: redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF), crestview_vsq_response_template.xlsx (Excel)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@crestviewhealth.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Trust portal invite + bridge letter (Redwood Inference)

Hi Priya / Alex — I’m Monica on Redwood’s security team. I’ve provisioned a read-only trust portal account for Priya and uploaded an interim bridge letter and a curated artifact package (control narratives, SOC 2 summary, encryption docs).

Portal invite:
- Link: https://trust.redwood-inference.com/invite/crestview/abcdef
- Temporary username: priya.shah+crestview@redwood-inference.com
- Temporary password: (sent via separate secure link)
- MFA: required on first login (TOTP supported).
- SSO: we can enable SAML if you prefer — send IdP metadata and we’ll coordinate.

What’s in the portal now (high level):
- Bridge letter (bridge_letter_redwood_2026-09.pdf) — explains scope and timeframe for the current SOC 2 Type II engagement
- SOC 2 artifact index (control narratives, evidence map) — the full Type II report is held under restricted access and requires an NDA / logos-only non-disclosure; we can grant access on request.
- Architecture diagrams and dataflow docs (PHI handling notes for HIPAA scope)

Next steps from our side:
1) If you want the unrestricted full Type II report, please share your legal contact for an NDA and we’ll route the request to the compliance team (typical turnaround 2–3 business days after NDA).
2) If you want to continue via the bridge letter + artifacts, confirm you can access the portal and we’ll accept the questionnaire responses in the portal or via the attached Excel.

Attachments: bridge_letter_redwood_2026-09.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Let me know if you’d prefer a short call to walk the artifact set — happy to do a 20-minute review with your security analyst this week.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <pshah@crestviewhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@crestviewhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trust portal invite + bridge letter (Redwood Inference)

Monica / Dylan — thanks, I was able to sign in and see the artifact index. A few quick notes from our side:

- Bridge letter: received and reviewed. That should be sufficient to proceed with initial procurement reviews.
- Full Type II report: we will need a copy for final legal sign-off. Please send the NDA contact / link and we’ll get that back to you tomorrow.
- Questionnaire: we’ll use your attached Excel template and return it by EOD Friday; I’ll own this.
- SSO: we’ll likely request SAML (Okta) for long-term access. I’ll share IdP metadata once procurement signals green light.

Can you also confirm whether the SOC 2 report covers encryption at rest for customer data and details on key management? I saw summary notes in the portal but want the control reference so I can mark it in our DSQ.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Priya Shah
Security Analyst | Crestview Health
